subject: Why is this verse yellow?
preview: Your highlights should mean something a year from now.
linkText: A Simple Bible Highlighting System That Actually Works

blocks.text: You picked up a highlighter before you ever asked why.
Everyone does.
A verse catches your eye, and you color it in.
It feels like study.
It feels like progress.
But then you flip back through your Bible a few months later.
Why is this verse yellow?
What did blue mean again?
Why is half the chapter glowing and the other half is not?
Here is what I want you to understand.
Highlighting without a plan does not create understanding. It creates color.
Most of us highlight the Bible the same way we highlighted a textbook in school.
Whatever looks important in the moment gets the color.
There is no rule behind it, so there is nothing to come back to later.
That is the problem I want to help you fix.
So I put together a simple Bible highlighting system that uses just four colors.
🍑 Peach: What don't I understand yet?
🔵 Blue: What does this reveal about God?
🟢 Green: What does this connect to?
🟡 Yellow: What is this saying to me personally?
One color. One question. Every single time.
That is what turns a colorful Bible into a record of what God has been teaching you.
In the full guide I walk through John 3:16 and Psalm 23 verse by verse, so you can watch the colors do their job on verses you already know.
